# [STORY] As a client app, I want an AI service backed by Ollama, so that the platform offers AI-driven features

## User Story
**As a** client app
**I want** an AI service backed by Ollama, including self-hosted speech-to-text voice control
**So that** the platform offers AI-driven features without depending on a third-party AI vendor

## Acceptance Criteria (Given/When/Then)
- [x] Given a client calls the AI service, when it needs a model-backed response, then Ollama integration serves it
- [x] Given a user wants voice control, when they use it, then a self-hosted speech-to-text service handles it instead of the third-party Alan AI
- [x] Given the ai-service is deployed, when it's live-verified against the real stack (Ollama, Postman/newman, e2e-smoke), then that verification passes

## Definition of Ready
- [x] Meets [Definition of Ready](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_READY.md)

## Story Points
**Estimate:** 13

## Definition of Done
- [x] Meets [Definition of Done](https://github.com/liviuionesi/lmdb.dev/blob/develop/docs/process/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md)
